events.address: Whistle & Fizz, 254 Greene St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: The final NYC date of Goodnotes' café takeover, with free specialty coffee, a student DJ and a casual study-break atmosphere at Whistle & Fizz.
events.what_is_free: Free coffee is advertised, and early arrivals can receive limited-edition Goodnotes merch while supplies last.
events.caveats: Free registration is required on the Goodnotes Luma page. The Luma page uses a normal Register flow and does not state host approval. Limited-edition gifts are for early arrivals and are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 1–4 PM at Whistle & Fizz. The date/time is confirmed by the current NYC event listing; the Goodnotes-hosted Luma page confirms the venue, free coffee, free merch and registration path.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square / 2 Herald Square, 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A public Hempz activation at Ulta Beauty Herald Square centered on Serene Waters with Magnesium Body Lotion, with a calm-down experience, product discovery and an outdoor beverage-truck component.
events.what_is_free: General pop-up access is open to the public. The public listing teases surprises but does not establish a guaranteed free product for every attendee.
events.caveats: The general 12:30–6:30 PM pop-up is advertised as open to the public with no RSVP requirement. A separate 4–6:30 PM Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet is a $25 ticketed experience and includes a $25 Ulta gift card; do not confuse that paid add-on with general pop-up admission.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM at/around Ulta Beauty Herald Square. Walk-in public access is established for the general activation; the influencer meet-and-greet is separate and paid.

events.address: Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar, 33 W 37th St, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A Korean skincare rooftop pop-up with skincare experiences, refreshments, a signature Golden Hour cocktail, creator networking and a take-home gift.
events.what_is_free: The event advertises refreshments, skincare experiences and a free gift. No purchase requirement is stated.
events.caveats: TWO-STEP RSVP REQUIRED: the Eventbrite organizer says registering on Eventbrite is not enough; registrants receive a separate official RSVP link by email and must complete that RSVP to fully secure a spot. The public pages do not state host approval, but capacity is limited and the event is explicitly creator-focused.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 1–4 PM at Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar. Sequin Soirée confirms the 1–4 PM afternoon window; Eventbrite's structured header displays an inconsistent AM label, while its own description calls it a Golden Hour afternoon pop-up. Use the 1–4 PM window and complete both registration steps.

occurrences.details: Free Luma registration required; free coffee and early-arrival merch while supplies last.
General pop-up is walk-in and free; separate influencer meet-and-greet is a paid $25 ticket.
Two-step RSVP required: Eventbrite registration plus the organizer's emailed official RSVP form.
